records.prompt: Write a short paragraph about the invention of the printing press.
records.text:
thought
The invention of the movable-type printing press by Johannes Gutenberg around the mid-15th century stands as one of the most transformative events in human history. By combining metal type with oil-based inks and a modified wine press, Gutenberg allowed for the rapid mass production of books, which were previously painstakingly hand-copied. This breakthrough broke the monopoly of the elite over knowledge, drastically lowering costs and making literacy accessible to the general public. Ultimately, the printing press acted as a vital catalyst for the Renaissance, the Reformation, and the Scientific Revolution, fundamentally reshaping how information is shared and preserved across the world.
